title: microk8s air-gapped runtime bundle, delta patcher, and Terraform provider fixes
author: Lina Ortega
release_notes: Adds official microk8s air-gapped bundle and Terraform/provider compatibility; reduces offline bundle size via delta patching; installer now performs microk8s-specific preflight checks.
description: Motivation: customers running on-prem developer clusters requested an officially supported microk8s air-gapped installer path. This PR introduces a microk8s-targeted offline bundle, a delta-based patcher to dramatically reduce archive size for incremental updates, Terraform/provider fixes to surface registry mirror and snap-specific hooks, and Helm chart adjustments so the runtime works consistently with microk8s networking and CRI defaults. Work includes: 1) new bundle layout under installer/airgap/bundles/microk8s with slim OCI layers and explicit snap hooks, 2) a delta_patcher service that computes binary deltas between bundle versions and an unpack-time apply step to keep download footprint small, 3) Terraform module changes to support microk8s node labeling, registry mirror variables, and a provider shim for the installer to write local registries, 4) Helm chart compatibility bits (service type normalization, tolerations, and adjusted readiness probes), 5) installer preflight checks that detect microk8s channel, snap versions, and available disk space, 6) test harness updates and CI job matrix expansion to include microk8s (snap) smoke tests. Checklist: - [x] bundle creation and signing - [x] delta patcher implementation and unit tests - [x] Terraform module updates and docs - [x] e2e smoke tests on microk8s-ubuntu and microk8s-coreos - [x] QA signoff and staged rollout plan.
commits: add: initial microk8s bundle layout and manifest generation | feat(patcher): delta_patcher implementation + unit tests | fix(terraform): registry mirror variables and provider shim | chore(ci): microk8s smoke job in helm-integration workflow | docs: microk8s install docs and troubleshooting notes
review_comments: Ava Chen: Can we ensure the delta_patcher uses a deterministic compression step so hashes are reproducible? Please add tests for that.
Lina Ortega: Added deterministic gzip flags and an integration test that validates stable hashes across runs.
Marcus Patel: Terraform changes look good but we should gate registry-mirror behind a feature flag until 1st customer validation.
Lina Ortega: Added variable enable_registry_mirror with sensible default=false and documented upgrade steps.
Diego Ruiz: Did e2e smoke run against a coreos-flavor microk8s? Networking behaved differently in my run.
Lina Ortega: Yes we added a coreos job to the CI matrix and adjusted CNI detection logic; I also added an ops note about iptables vs nft fallback.
Ava Chen: Approved after minor comments addressed.
testing_instructions: Create a local registry mirror and import the microk8s bundle using installer/bin/redwood-install --airgap --bundle path/to/microk8s-bundle.tar.gz --target microk8s. For Terraform: set module variable enable_registry_mirror=true and run terraform apply; verify that installer writes the local mirror config to /etc/containerd/config.toml on nodes. Run tests/tests/e2e/microk8s/smoke_test.sh against the cluster and confirm redwood pods reach Ready within 6 minutes.
rollback_plan: If issues are detected, run installer/bin/redwood-install --rollback --target microk8s which will revert applied k8s manifests and unregister local registry entries; Terraform changes are backwards-compatible when enable_registry_mirror=false, so revert the module version to the previous tag (v1.12.3) and run terraform apply to restore prior state.
